reason: Board certification exemption by degree (2026-11-18). Only the WA DO rule text changed: its moc now also names MOC participation, which WAC 246-853-080(2)(b) lists: "Meet the requirements for participation in maintenance of certification of a member board of the ABOMS or ABMS at the time of renewal" (app.leg.wa.gov/wac/default.aspx?cite=246-853-080). moc was "ABOMS or ABMS cert/recert within last 6 yrs, current AOA CME certificate, or AMA PRA satisfies 150 hrs; state mandates still required" and is now "ABOMS or ABMS cert/recert within last 6 yrs, ABOMS or ABMS MOC participation at renewal, current AOA CME certificate, or AMA PRA satisfies 150 hrs; state mandates still required". The rule entry (getStateReq, getStateEntry) and the evidence pack that quotes it (evidence:WA:DO) carry that string; no hours, cycle, topic or compliance result moved.
